description:
Treasure Hunt: Download v2.3.0

GitHub Repo

The goal of this mod is to make the hunt for rare blueprints and colony items more consistent and less rage-inducing. It adds a new event intel which represents your ongoing efforts to find rare blueprints and colony items. Like with the Hyperspace Topography event, it progresses naturally with normal gameplay, but can also be engaged with actively for faster progress. Unlike regular salvaging, the rewards are far more consistent, and you get a fair degree of control over what you find.

The rewards themselves and the ways that you can gain progress are very configurable. All config items can be found in treasurehunt_settings.json in the main directory of the mod, and in settings.json, found in the data/config directory.

Progress the event by:

Exploring derelict stations and ships
Exploring planetary ruins and colonizing them
Fighting or paying scavengers
Raiding markets

A more detailed explanation for these mechanics can be found in the readme.

Compatibility

It is safe to add this mod to your existing save.
It is not safe to remove this mod from your save.
While there should be no compatibility issues with other mods, there is no by-default integration with them yet, either. So that derelict pet center won't give you any progress when you salvage it unless you add that behavior to settings.json yourself.
It usually is not safe to upgrade the mod version mid-save.

Credits
Thanks to the users at the USC discord for providing the technical support I needed to get started. This is my first attempt at a mod, and I would have given up without them.

I'm happy to hear your feedback and ideas for future development.

discordPostHtml:
Ever get annoyed at not finding that one blueprint or colony item? This mod adds a new event intel and set of mechanics for progressing it that provides a more consistent set of rewards than the dice roll of station and ruins salvaging.

Github: https://github.com/spinloki/TreasureHunt
Forum: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=33016.0
Direct Download: https://github.com/spinloki/TreasureHunt/releases/download/v2.3.0/TreasureHunt.zip
aiDescription: Adds an event intel system for finding rare blueprints and colony items. Progresses naturally with gameplay or through active engagement like exploring derelicts, colonizing ruins, fighting scavengers, or raiding markets. Rewards are consistent and configurable via JSON settings.

removalCompatibilityText: It is not safe to remove this mod from your save.

gallery.aiCaption: A screenshot of the Treasure Hunt mod interface showing progress bars, descriptive text about salvaging relics, and lists of remaining treasures and monthly factors.

changelog.0.2.4:
Fixed:
 Incorrect price displayed when buying treasure hunt info from scavengers
 Blueprint reward packages showing up as loot (hopefully, let me know if you still see this happening)
 Weird possible edge case where progress isn't awarded properly if the player is fighting a mix of scavengers and non-scavengers in a single battle
 Progress is now awarded for most salvageable entities, like supply/equipment/weapon caches.
 Changed:
 Added progress reward for debris field and raiding any market, including pirate/pather stations.
 Moved a lot of customization for reward values from treasurehunt_settings.json to settings.json for the mod. You can now add entries for any salvageable thing in the game, as long as you know the custom description ID. If you don't want to be rewarded for certain actions, you can also safely remove their entry from settings.json.
changelog.0.2.3:
Removed mod enable setting in treasurehunt_settings.json, which didn't do anything
 Fixed a bug that awarded all Treasure Hunt actions the amount for salvaging a derelict station
changelog.0.2.2:
Added a bunch of custom blueprint packages instead of just giving single capital ship blueprints as rewards. You can now get all the rare vanilla blueprints.
 Fixed that duplicate factor issue that several people have experienced. Let me know if you experience it again, but it shouldn't ever come back now.
 Removed the placeholder assets in favor of using some vanilla assets as placeholders instead. They're less offensive to look at, at least.
 I will note that if you update versions mid-save, the "unseen item" pool will be reset.
 EDIT: There seems to be an issue where derelict ships now award excessive amounts of event progress. This is a bug that I found while making this version, but I thought I'd fixed it before release. I'll have this fixed later today.
